about_the_game:
[Go Ape Ship!’s cockpit and Moon voyage are completely free to play. A one-time upgrade to unlock the ship gives access to 7 additional rooms—each with their own set of mini games—and 5 new cosmic destinations.]

Go Ape Ship! is a frantic co-op multiplayer game for one to eight players. Work with your crew of daring Astrochimps to master an expanding collection of tasks, respond to emergencies, unlock new rooms and upgrades for your spaceship, and safely reach the stars. Survive together. Or not at all.

WORK TOGETHER

In space, only your crewmates can hear you scream! Keep your spaceship on track by helping each other out with cooperative mini games. Be a pal and revive your downed teammates. Remember to ONLY use the reflex hammer to knock out your crewmates when it is medically necessary. And definitely DON’T vent your friends into the dark and lonely void of outer space. Unless they deserve it.

MAN YOUR STATIONS

It’s time to get down to monkey business! Fulfill your duties by completing the exciting mini games assigned to you. Adjust thrusters, power shields, cook delicious meals, poop in the bathroom (or not), and much more! But don’t take too long, or things on your spaceship can go awry: fires, hull breaches, and space viruses, oh my!

UNLOCK YOUR SPACESHIP’S FULL POTENTIAL

Your spaceship is your home away from home planet. As you successfully complete missions, you’ll earn research points based on your performance. Use these hard-won points to unlock additional rooms in your spaceship, each with its own set of new mini games, and to furnish them with helpful upgrades.

TRAVEL THE STARS

Bon voyage! Journey to 6 destinations across the Solar System. But beware! As you travel further from sweet Mother Earth, you’ll be assigned more tasks to keep your spaceship spaceworthy, and space emergencies will become increasingly common.

FEATURES:

  • Travel the stars with a trusty crew of 1 to 8 players!

  • Master more than 40 exciting mini games to operate your spaceship, respond to emergencies, and keep your Astrochimps fit for duty!

  • Explore, unlock, and upgrade your spaceship’s 8 distinct rooms!

  • Challenge yourself across 6 difficulty settings, including an endless mode, to trek across the Solar System and beyond!

  • Play solo offline or with friends online!

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 (base) OR Intel quad-core i5 + Metal 2-capable dGPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: API: Metal
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Rosetta not required, controller support
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Sequoia or newer
  • Processor: M1 Pro or M2
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: M1 Pro or M2
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (22H2) or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100 (or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / GTX 1050, AMD Radeon R9 380 / RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Controller support

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: i5-11400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RX 580 (6–8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
